notablePrerequisites: An opponent does not control a creature that matches the color chosen with Lurebound Scarecrow.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Lurebound Scarecrow to an opponent who controls no creatures which match the color named by Lurebound Scarecrow.
When Lurebound Scarecrow's controller controls no creatures which match the color named by it, Lurebound Scarecrow triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Lurebound Scarecrow cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Lurebound Scarecrow triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
